intervals.note: Earliest dated evidence for the collaboration's experiment (start of solar-neutrino measurement per the SAGE Collaboration's 2009 paper), not a formation date; the formation date is not sourced.
intervals.quote: The Russian-American experiment SAGE began to measure the solar neutrino capture rate with a target of gallium metal in December 1989.

leadership.note: Wikipedia names Vladimir Gavrin, Georgiy Zatsepin and Thomas J. Bowles as leading physicists on the experiment, without dates or explicit titles.

name: SAGE Collaboration
notes: No membership counts or dedicated official site were found in a source consulted (checked 2026-09-18); the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research (Russia) and Los Alamos National Laboratory (USA) are named as participants on Wikipedia, without a full institution list.

summary.plain: The Russian-American team, including physicists Vladimir Gavrin, Georgiy Zatsepin and Thomas Bowles, who built and run the SAGE gallium solar-neutrino experiment.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating SAGE at Baksan; participants include the Institute for Nuclear Research (Russia) and Los Alamos National Laboratory (USA); membership counts not found in the sources consulted.
